description:
Impact Guns is a reputable firearms retailer based in Boise, Idaho, serving the Treasure Valley community. As a trusted resource for gun enthusiasts and first-time buyers alike, Impact Guns provides an extensive selection of handguns, rifles, shotguns, and accessories from top manufacturers. Their knowledgeable staff is well-versed in firearm safety, maintenance, and operation, ensuring customers receive expert guidance throughout their purchasing experience.

Impact Guns prides itself on fostering a welcoming environment for both seasoned shooters and newcomers to the sport. Their commitment to community engagement extends beyond sales, with regular events and workshops designed to promote firearms education, training, and camaraderie among local gun owners.

Located in the heart of Boise, Impact Guns is conveniently situated near major highways and attractions, making it easily accessible for Treasure Valley residents and visitors alike. With a wide range of products and services available, including transfers and background checks, Impact Guns is an essential resource for anyone seeking to purchase or learn about firearms in Idaho's capital city. For the most up-to-date information on their current inventory, events, and services, we encourage you to contact them directly at (800) 917-7137 or visit their website at https://www.impactguns.com.
